ayahOccurrences.text: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: كَدَأْبِ is in the derivative form: دَأْبٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/أ/ب   d–ʾ–b custom, habit, persistence, to persevere, to do regularly, day and night.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 6 times in the Qur’an:
دَأْبٌ daʾb 5 times and دَائِبَيْن dāʾibayn 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
دَأْبٌ daʾb [n./v. n.]

1 way, custom, manner; habit, attitude; case, situation

(3:11) كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ like [the case/attitude/way of] Pharaoh’s people and their predecessors, they denied Our revelations, and God punished them for their sins

2 [adverbially] ‘as usual’, ‘in the way it has been done’

(12:47) قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًا he said, ‘You should sow for seven [consecutive] years as usual.’

entries.label: دَائِبَيْن
entries.definitionHtml:
دَائِبَيْن dāʾibayn [dual of act. part. دَائِبٌ dāʾib] constant, diligent

(14:33) وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ دَائِبَيْنِ He has made the sun and the moon useful to you, constant on their paths.
